summary: CRITICAL: Submission is incomplete. matrix-generator.sh references 'include "matrix"' (lib/matrix module) that is not provided; workflow expects fixtures/ci-example.json, fixtures/ci-example-with-rules.json, tests/matrix_generator.bats (with exactly 19 cases), and .actrc that are absent. The act-test-harness cannot run without these. What IS shown has merit: workflow YAML is well-structured (proper permissions, job dependencies, outputs), shell scripts follow conventions (shebang, pipefail, error handling), and test harness pattern is sound. But the deliverable is non-functional without its critical dependencies.
